bash: Run a bash command (build, test, git).
edit: Replace unique oldString with newString in filePath.
grep: Regex search of file contents; include = file glob.
question: Ask the user a question.
read: Read filePath as numbered lines (offset, limit).
skill: Load a listed skill by name.
task: Run a sub-agent (subagent_type) on a self-contained prompt.
todowrite: Replace the todo list (content, status, priority).
tool_search: Find MCP tools by keyword; matches load next turn.
webfetch: Fetch a URL as markdown, text or html.
write: Create or overwrite filePath with content.
